carriers.why: You pick the carrier when uploading an invoice; DeciShip reads the invoice using that carrier's layout and compares it with its tariff. Select all the carriers you work with; you can also add more later on the Tariffs page.
carriers.legend: Carriers (you can select more than one)

hint.other: If it is not listed, enter its name yourself

carriers.otherNameHelp: E.g. Sürat Kargo. You will map the invoice columns on the first upload.

rules.why: The values are pre-filled with recommended defaults; most companies confirm them as they are. You can change all of them later under Settings.

mobile.title: Measurement in the warehouse (mobile app)
mobile.divisorHelp: The employee's screen calculates dimensional weight with this (usually 3000 for domestic, 5000 for express). Invoices are compared using the divisor in the tariff. A 40×30×25 box = {{desi}} dimensional weight
mobile.photosHelp: Every measurement requires at least this many box photos. They serve as evidence in disputes; 1 is recommended, 0 turns photos off.

tol.title: Comparison tolerances
tol.desc: Small deviations within these limits are not counted as differences, so rounding and scale differences do not clutter the list.
tol.edgeHelp: This margin is added to every edge of your measurement. If the carrier's weight falls within it, the line counts as compliant. Enter 0 to apply no margin.
tol.weightHelp: Counts as a weight discrepancy if the billed kg exceeds your measurement by this much.
tol.amountHelp: Anything above the expected amount by this much counts as a price difference. Entered in your company's currency; converted at the exchange rate on foreign-currency invoices.
tol.fxHelp: If the tariff is in another currency, a deviation up to this percentage from the converted amount is an exchange-rate effect, not a difference.
tol.unknownSurcharges: Count surcharges not in the tariff as differences
tol.unknownSurchargesHelp: Off (recommended): surcharges that are not defined in your tariff (e.g. import service fee) are added to Expected at the invoiced amount, and differences arise only from items the tariff defines. On: these charges are counted entirely as differences.

errors.divisor: Enter a whole number between 1000 and 10000.

tariffs.why: A tariff is the price list you have agreed with the carrier. DeciShip uses it to calculate "what I should have paid" for every invoice line; invoices from a carrier without a tariff are read but cannot be compared ("No tariff"). Upload the PDF or Excel file the carrier sent you; if you have no file, you can enter the prices manually.
tariffs.hasSamples_one: You uploaded {{count}} sample invoice: when importing from a PDF, the tables that match the service on your invoices are pre-selected. Once a tariff is added, the invoices are compared automatically below.
tariffs.hasSamples_other: You uploaded {{count}} sample invoices: when importing from a PDF, the tables that match the service on your invoices are pre-selected. Once a tariff is added, the invoices are compared automatically below.
tariffs.tip: Tip: if you upload a sample invoice first, the right tables in the PDF are selected automatically and your tariff is checked against real prices.
tariffs.tariffBound: A tariff is tied to a carrier.
tariffs.templateLead: If you are preparing your own list,
tariffs.templateTail: , fill it in and import it with "Upload PDF / Excel".

check.title: Your sample invoices against the tariff
check.desc: "Tariff match" shows whether the prices on the invoice agree with your tariff. If a country does not match (e.g. a country-specific discount), you can add it to the tariff with one click.

tariffs.missing: There is no tariff for {{names}}. Invoices from these carriers cannot be compared. You can skip this for now and add one later on the Tariffs page.

presets.why: Define the standard boxes you use often: the employee picks one with a single tap on mobile, the dimensions fill in automatically and a measurement takes seconds. K1–K3 were added as examples; change them to your own sizes, and delete or deactivate the ones you do not use.

invoices.pdfDisabled: PDF reading is off; upload CSV or Excel.
invoices.why: Add an invoice from your carrier as a sample only. DeciShip uses it to select the right tables in your tariff PDF and to check your tariff against real prices.
invoices.needCarrier: Add a carrier first to upload a sample invoice.
invoices.readingPdf: The PDF is being read with AI, which can take 10–30 seconds.
